name: call-signal
description: One buying signal read from a call transcript (BO-F1-08: budget, tempi, interesse, dubbi), extracted by the workspace LLM through the call-intelligence summarize operation. transcriptRef names the transcript row it was read from and excerpt quotes it word for word, so every signal carries its source in the transcript. Append-only and immutable. (backlog:588db7766206)
